JAINA_RELIC_EVEN_MATCH.title: Even Match
JAINA_RELIC_EVEN_MATCH.description: At the start of each combat, gain a Lucky Coin.
JAINA_RELIC_EVEN_MATCH.flavor: An evenly matched duel — victory hangs by a thread.
JAINA_RELIC_EVEN_MATCH_ANCIENT.title: Prying the Opponent's End Turn Button
JAINA_RELIC_EVEN_MATCH_ANCIENT.descripti: At the start of each combat, gain a Lucky Coin and draw 1 card.
JAINA_RELIC_EVEN_MATCH_ANCIENT.flavor: Before your opponent can end their turn, you've already won it.
JAINA_RELIC_ARCANE_AMPLIFIER_RELIC.title: Arcane Amplifier
JAINA_RELIC_ARCANE_AMPLIFIER_RELIC.descr: Your Hero Power deals 2 extra damage.
JAINA_RELIC_ARCANE_AMPLIFIER_RELIC.flavo: Arcane energy surges within, and your spells burn ever brighter.
JAINA_RELIC_BOOK_OF_SECRETS_RELIC.title: Book of Secrets
JAINA_RELIC_BOOK_OF_SECRETS_RELIC.descri: At the start of each combat, randomly gain 3 Mage spells.
JAINA_RELIC_BOOK_OF_SECRETS_RELIC.flavor: Every page holds a winning spell.
Whenever you Discover a card on your turn, deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
There's always something useful at the very bottom.
JAINA_RELIC_APPRENTICE_OF_THE_MAGI_RELIC: At the start of each turn, your first Arcane spell costs 1 less.
A young apprentice's first foray into the arcane is full of surprises.
JAINA_RELIC_FROST_TONGUE_CENTAUR_RELIC.d: After you cast a Frost spell, summon a 1/1 Frost Elemental.
JAINA_RELIC_FROST_TONGUE_CENTAUR_RELIC.f: Each neigh of this centaur's frost tongue solidifies into a frozen elemental.
JAINA_RELIC_FIRE_SPREAD_RELIC.title: Fire Spread
JAINA_RELIC_FIRE_SPREAD_RELIC.descriptio: At the start of each combat, draw 3 cards and give them Retain and Ignite.
JAINA_RELIC_FIRE_SPREAD_RELIC.flavor: The fire spreads — the sooner you draw a card, the sooner it catches.
JAINA_RELIC_SIF_RELIC.title: Sif
JAINA_RELIC_SIF_RELIC.description: [gold]+1 Strength[/gold]. (Increases for each spell school you have cast this combat!)
JAINA_RELIC_SIF_RELIC.flavor: The schools of magic converge in her hands, becoming pure might.
SEA_GLASS.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.title: Frost Glass
